This block keeps the primaries protected: strict One-Arm Pull-up plus the compact heavy Back Squat on Mon, easy assisted One-Arm Pull-up on Tue, a deliberately low-cost support day on Fri, and direct Overhead Press plus the lighter Back Squat on Sun. The marathon side quest stays as one easy long run each week so running specificity is preserved without stealing from MMA or the primary goals.

The long run is held at the tolerated dose. Week 4 keeps the best Week 3 standards with less total work and a shorter long run.

If elbows or forearms get irritated, make Monday One-Arm Pull-up all singles and do not reduce assistance on Tuesday that week. If knee or hip fatigue spikes, trim the Sunday Back Squat first rather than the Monday heavy exposure. If the run starts beating up calves or shins, hold or reduce the distance and keep the pace easy; on Friday, drop Calf Raise first if MMA fatigue is high.

START_WEEK1_TSV
Day	Exercise	Weight	Sets	Reps	Rest	Target RPE	Notes	Results
Mon	[WARMUP] Deep Squat Hold	BW	2	30 sec	30 sec	3	General prep before strict pulling: easy Pull-up x 5 and Assisted One-Arm Pull-up x 1 per side; squat-and-reach x 6; bodyweight squat x 8; band pull-apart x 10-12; band shoulder pass-through x 10; wall slide x 8. Keep it specific and non-fatiguing.; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Keep the warm-up specific and non-fatiguing.	
Mon	[WARMUP] Back Squat	20 kg -> 155 kg	5	1-8	60-90 sec	3	Empty bar and ramp sets before work sets: 20 kg x 8, 60 kg x 5, 100 kg x 3, 140 kg x 1-2, 155 kg x 1. Stop well short of fatigue.	
Mon	One-Arm Pull-up	BW	3	1-2 per arm	2-3 min	7.5-8	Weaker arm first. Per arm: aim for 2 + 1 + 1 only if the opener is crisp; otherwise use 1 + 1 + 1. Stop before grind or elbow flare. Week 1 standard: establish the benchmark - every single starts from a dead hang, no kip or swing, and you finish each side with at least one clean rep still in reserve. Record how each side felt; this is the standard Weeks 2-3 have to beat.	
Mon	Back Squat	Set 1 167.5 kg; Sets 2-3 160 kg	3	3	3-4 min	7.5-8	Compact heavy exposure. Stop after 2 sets if the top set overshoots the RPE cap, depth slips, or bar speed clearly falls.	
Mon	Push Press	RPE-selected load	2	3	2-3 min	7	Low-dose overload support for Overhead Press; crisp dip-drive, no grind.	
Mon	Cable Row	RPE-selected load	2	8	90 sec	7	Foundational horizontal pull support with a quiet torso and full squeeze.	
Mon	Side Plank	BW	2	30-45 sec per side	30-45 sec	7	Trunk stiffness for squatting and grappling; keep ribs down.	
Tue	[WARMUP] Band Pull-Apart Warm-up	Light band	2	15	30 sec	3	Shoulder and scap prep; then ramp assistance gradually.; Squat-and-reach x 6; Bodyweight squat x 8; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12; Band shoulder pass-through x 10; Scapular push-up x 8; Keep the warm-up specific and non-fatiguing.	
Tue	Assisted One-Arm Pull-up	Minimal assistance	2	1 per arm	90-120 sec	6-6.5	Each side. Keep ROM and tempo symmetrical. If Monday left elbows or grip flat, keep the same assistance and just make the singles cleaner. Recovery-first pulling microdose: technical adjacent-day exposure only, keep it at RPE 6-6.5 or easier and stop well before local fatigue.	
Tue	Cable Row	RPE-selected load	2	8	90 sec	7	Foundational pulling after One-Arm Pull-up skill work; no hitching or lean-back.	
Tue	Dumbbell Bench Press	RPE-selected load	2	6-8	90-120 sec	7	Maintenance press dose; stop 2-3 reps short of failure.	
Tue	Pallof Press	RPE-selected load	2	10-12 per side	45-60 sec	6	Brace and resist rotation; clean pauses on each rep.	
Thu	Run	Easy conversational pace	1	18 km	N/A	5-6	Long run. Stay clearly below threshold; if drift gets high, add short walk breaks and keep the pace easy.	
Fri	[WARMUP] Band Pull-Apart Warm-up	Light band	2	15	30 sec	3	Quick shoulder prep for the low-cost support day.; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12; Band shoulder pass-through x 10; Scapular push-up x 8; Keep the warm-up specific and non-fatiguing.; Squat-and-reach x 6; Bodyweight squat x 8	
Fri	Back Squat	140 kg	2	4	2-3 min	6.5	Lower-cost squat exposure. Move crisply and leave plenty in reserve for Monday.	
Fri	Leg Press Machine	RPE-selected load	2	8	2 min	6.5	Low-cost lower support on the hard sport day; smooth reps and stop well before grind.	
Fri	Machine Hamstring Curl	RPE-selected load	2	8	60-90 sec	6.5	Easy posterior-chain support on the hard sport day.	
Fri	Calf Raise	RPE-selected load	2	12	45-60 sec	7	Tissue-capacity work for running and MMA footwork.	
Sun	[WARMUP] Band Pull-Apart Warm-up	Light band	2	15	30 sec	3	Prep shoulders first, then ramp squat and press gradually.; Squat-and-reach x 6; Bodyweight squat x 8; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12; Band shoulder pass-through x 10; Wall slide x 8; Ramp Back Squat: 55 kg x 5, 85 kg x 3, 110 kg x 1-2 before 140 kg work sets.; Ramp Overhead Press: 27.5 kg x 5, 42.5 kg x 3, 55 kg x 1-2 before 70 kg work sets.; Keep the warm-up specific and non-fatiguing.	
Sun	Overhead Press	70 kg	2	4	2-3 min	7.5	Direct strict press. If the second set already feels above cap, keep this load next week instead of forcing the jump.	
Sun	Machine Hamstring Curl	RPE-selected load	2	8	60-90 sec	6.5	Posterior-chain support with low soreness cost before Monday's heavier squat day.	
Sun	Side Plank	BW	2	30-45 sec per side	30-45 sec	7	Trunk stiffness for pressing and squatting; keep ribs stacked over pelvis.
